title: The config cue regex /\bconfig(?:uration)?\b/i is broad and will match nearly a…
description:
The config cue regex /\bconfig(?:uration)?\b/i is broad and will match nearly any PRD that mentions 'config'/'configuration', which may add a low-signal 'Configuration change' row to the setup checklist for most PRs. Consider narrowing it or ordering it last. Non-blocking.

Source: cam/issue-52
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: 02c8b87e4b5e

spec.scope: Narrow the 'Configuration change' setup-checklist cue in src/release/pr-body.ts so it stops firing on incidental prose mentions of 'config'/'configuration' while still detecting genuine configuration-change/setup actions. The current cue /\bconfig(?:uration)?\b/i (SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES, the last/6th entry) matches any standalone 'config'/'configuration' word in the newline-joined haystack of prd.description + prd.notes + story titles, adding a low-signal 'Configuration change' row to nearly any PR that mentions config in passing. The cue is ALREADY ordered last, so ordering is not the fix: narrowing the pattern is. Replace the bare-word match with a context-requiring pattern (config/configuration co-occurring with a change/setup signal, e.g. an action verb like new/update/change/edit/add/set or a config-artifact token such as project.toml or a config file), keeping the cue as the last array entry and preserving the existing { pattern, item, where, how } row shape and the .filter every-match semantics. No other cue is modified.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Configuration change' row is NOT emitted when the PRD mentions config/configuration only incidentally (e.g. description 'the configuration option is already documented' / 'no configuration changes are required'), verified by a NEW negative test in test/release/pr-body.test.ts asserting the rendered PR body does NOT contain 'Configuration change' for such input.

The 'Configuration change' row IS still emitted when the PRD describes a genuine configuration change requiring operator setup (e.g. 'add a new key to project.toml' or 'update the configuration value in project.toml'), verified by a NEW positive test asserting the rendered PR body contains 'Configuration change'.

The config cue remains the LAST entry in SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES with item 'Configuration change' and its { pattern, item, where, how } row shape unchanged; no other cue's pattern or behavior is modified and all existing pr-body tests still pass.
bun run typecheck, bun test, and bun run check:all all pass with zero errors.
gotchas: SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES selection is Array.filter (EVERY matching cue adds its own row), not first-match-wins; the config cue is already the LAST array entry, so 'ordering it last' from the issue text is already done and a no-op: narrowing the pattern is the substantive fix.

The haystack is [prd.description ?? '', prd.notes ?? '', ...story.title].join('\n') in renderSetupChecklist (pr-body.ts ~line 142); story descriptions/bodies are NOT scanned. Put test cue text in description/notes or a story title accordingly.

There is currently NO test exercising the config cue specifically; the existing 'detects a config/install/migration cue from a story title alone' test input only triggers the migration cue and asserts 'Database migration'. Add dedicated positive + negative config-cue tests.
Existing tests assert via body.toContain(...) substring on the rendered markdown, not exact row-label equality.

'configurable' and 'reconfigure' already do NOT match the current word-boundary pattern, so the false-positive class is genuine STANDALONE 'config'/'configuration' prose words; the narrowing must target those, not derived words.
noUncheckedIndexedAccess: guard any regex capture-group access. Bun-only invariants apply; keep this file and test Bun-first.
